edges.rationale: The job description mentions that the DevOps architect will work with Kubernetes.
Docker is mentioned as part of the technical stack.
Jenkins is also part of the technical stack and will be used for automated testing and deployment.
GitLab is another tool mentioned in the job description that the DevOps architect will work with.
While AWS is not explicitly required, it's part of the technical stack and will be used for deployment. The DevOps architect may use other cloud platforms as well.
Similarly, Azure is also part of the technical stack and will be used for deployment.
Google Cloud is another cloud platform that the DevOps architect may use.
Both problem-solving and analysis skills are required for this role.
The experienced DevOps architect will be implementing the DevOps architect domain responsibilities.
Soft skills and problem-solving skills are related but distinct categories.
